description: In an Archimedean ordered field, for every positive epsilon some natural number n satisfies 1/(n+1) less than epsilon.
signature:
exists_nat_one_div_lt.{u_4} {K : Type u_4} [Semifield K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Archimedean K] {ε : K}
  (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n, 1 / (↑n + 1) < ε
